summary: Frontend-only E2E against local Firebase emulators (arsh_use_emulator=1, test.arshnaz@example.com / Test123456) focusing on the login redesign (line angel), onboarding alignment, weekly/monthly guided Planning review, and Values & Goals integration at the year level. All in-scope features worked end-to-end. Verified: (1) /auth renders with data-testid auth-page, auth-wordmark 'ARSHNAZ', auth-angel-art SVG (visible after 3.5s draw-in), email-in-input, pass-in-input, pass-in-toggle (type cycles password↔text), auth-forgot-password, auth-disclaimer-checkbox (role=checkbox, data-state unchecked→checked), auth-signin-submit. (2) Submitting WITHOUT ticking disclaimer stays on /auth (highlight state applied), submitting WITH disclaimer + credentials lands on /app/today. (3) Mode switch: auth-tab-signup swaps title to 'ساخت حساب تازه' and shows name-up-input / email-up-input / pass-up-input / auth-signup-submit; auth-tab-signin returns. (4) Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (sw=cw=390), angel art (y=40,h=224) sits above the form (y=385). (5) Dark mode on /auth: html.dark toggled via devtools yields bg rgb(25,16,22) (dark plum) with angel still visible. (6) Onboarding dialog appears on first login (data-testid onboarding-dialog) with ivory styling + AngelLineArt; stepping through onboarding-next shows the planning step 'از هدف سال تا کار امروز'; onboarding-cta/-skip/-next all present. (7) Planning week level: planning-review-banner + planning-review-start visible on 2026-10-02 (last day of current Jalali week). planning-review-open opens planning-review-dialog with score '۱ از ۲'; 1 open item (w1) listed as planning-review-open-w1 with move/done/drop buttons. planning-review-next-input + Enter creates item in next week (verified by navigating planning-next → 'QA_REVIEW_NEXT_WK_V2' present in planning-main). planning-review-drop-w1 removes w1 from plan (lands in unplanned tray). planning-review-note accepts text. planning-review-finish closes dialog and the banner disappears after finish (expected behavior). (8) Month level: planning-level-month + planning-review-open opens same dialog correctly. (9) Year level: planning-values-panel renders with g1 ('هر هفته سه بار ورزش') and g2 ('خواندن ۱۲ کتاب'); each row has planning-value-goal-<id> + planning-value-add-<id>. planning-values-open links to /app/values. Clicking planning-value-add-g1 adds a year item (chip count 0→1) with chip '💪 سلامت، ورزش و بدن' (plan-value-chip-*), and the g1 row flips to 'در برنامه' and the add button disappears. (10) Mobile 390x844 at year level: planning-pane-upper tab visible and switching to it shows planning-values-panel. (11) Regression: plan-upper-pull-m1 still visible at week level; /app/today still shows 'خلاصه‌نویسی…' (d1).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth.tsx (~290 lines) is well-structured with a small inline PasswordInput sub-component; disclaimer highlight ring + localStorage persistence is clean.

AngelLineArt.tsx uses pathLength=1 with staggered animationDelay for a graceful draw-in; a combined fillRule=evenodd ink path is a nice touch for solidifying lines once drawn. One SVG viewBox is used; stroke+fill both use --auth-line so dark mode automatically keeps lines visible (bg rgb(25,16,22) confirms).
Onboarding.tsx reuses AngelLineArt and auth-theme/auth-grain classes — the new planning step 'stepPlan' is wired behind isPathAllowed, matching the request.

PeriodReview.tsx (~106 lines) is focused and testable; reviewDue correctly uses current.end == today for the banner and persists via arsh_plan_review_v1:<uid>:<horizon>:<start> in localStorage. Dispatching 'arsh:plan-reviewed' event to force a re-check is a clean pattern.
ValuesGoalsPanel.tsx correctly uses linked = tasks.filter(source_type='values_goal') to flip the row to 'در برنامه'. domainOf lookup via VALUE_DOMAINS provides the chip emoji + fa/en label.

PlanningBoard.tsx integrates all four new pieces (banner, header review button, year-level ValuesGoalsPanel, mobile pane fallback to 'از ارزش‌ها' when no parent level) in ~220 lines — within guideline.

Minor dev-ergo note (not a bug): /auth prints a benign Firestore 401 and Vite WSS error — both are expected in this preview container (pre-auth emulator read + external Vite HMR not reachable through the proxy). Can be filtered in future test setups.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope items (login redesign, onboarding, planning review, values & goals linking, mobile + dark, regression)

seed_data_creation: Seed from /app/tests/emulator/start.sh (y1,y2,q1,m1,m2,w1,w2,old1,d1,u1,u2,g1,g2) was used. State changes left in the emulator after this run: (a) 'QA_REVIEW_NEXT_WK_V2' added via review dialog in next week; (b) w1 was dropped from plan via planning-review-drop-w1 → now in unplanned tray; (c) a year item linked to g1 was created via planning-value-add-g1 (so g1 now shows 'در برنامه'); (d) current-week review was recorded in localStorage key arsh_plan_review_v1:<uid>:week:<start>. Re-run `sh /app/tests/emulator/start.sh` for a pristine seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Firebase auth persists in IndexedDB — to simulate a 'fresh browser' context (for onboarding or /auth tests after a prior login), delete all IndexedDB databases AND clear localStorage, else the user is auto-redirected to /app/today. Use `wait_until='domcontentloaded'` on /app/* routes — 'networkidle' can time out because Firestore keeps a long-poll connection open. The disclaimer checkbox is a shadcn Checkbox (button[role=checkbox]) with data-state attribute, so use .click() + check get_attribute('data-state'). planning-review-banner only shows when today == period.end AND no review stored yet for that period; after planning-review-finish it is correctly hidden. For emulator pre-auth 401 noise and Vite 'wss://localhost' errors, both are benign in this preview container.
